description: This is an HTML source file that implements the frontend UI for a database visualizer/manager. It includes site structure, styles, and embedded JavaScript for interacting with backend API endpoints to list databases, tables, and display table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching from backend.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual table cell content, handling expandable objects and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for readability.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading indicator in the specified element.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message in the specified element.

methods.name: showEmptyState
methods.description: Displays an empty state message when no data is available.

methods.name: setActiveState
methods.description: Highlights the active database or table in the UI.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Performs a fetch request and parses JSON response, throwing on error.
